prompt:
Rewrite snippets/preorder-notice-2.liquid so it renders a grouped preorder notice for product variants. Input (top-level variable, always supplied): - `variants`: array, never null but may be empty. Each element is an object that always has exactly these keys: `title` (string, never null), `available` (boolean), `preorder_date` (string or null). Rules: 1. A preorder variant is one whose `available` is false AND whose `preorder_date`, with leading and trailing whitespace removed, is non-empty. All other variants (available true, or null/empty/whitespace-only date) are ignored completely. DATE below always means the stripped `preorder_date`. 2. If there are no preorder variants, output nothing at all (empty string). 3. Otherwise output exactly, with no whitespace or newlines between tags: `
    ROWS

N preorder option

` where N is the number of preorder variants; use `option` when N is 1 and `options` otherwise. 4. ROWS: one `
  • ` per preorder variant, in input order. If the variant is the first preorder variant, or its DATE differs from the DATE of the previous preorder variant (the most recent preceding variant that qualified under rule 1; ignored variants in between do not count and do not reset anything), the row is `
  • Ships DATE TITLE
    • ` (one space between `` and the title). Otherwise the row is `
  • TITLE
    • `. Dates are compared after stripping whitespace, case-sensitively. 5. DATE and TITLE must be HTML-escaped (escape filter). Nothing may be output before ``. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/preorder-notice-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
